floorPlans.introduction: Choose a published layout in Buildings A, B or C. The PDF and physical-page source link follow the selected building. Ranges retain every unit-group total printed on its sheet.
floorPlans.note: Building C uses the official Emaar download. Buildings A and B use separately reviewed Emaar booklets hosted by broker Mitchell’s. Total area includes the listed balcony or terrace; it is not plot area or current inventory. Confirm the unit and final sale plan.
